# Module `vllm`

vllm — Vyb standard-library model-runtime engine (module).

Shared by BOTH VybOS and VybForge (one shared core, multiple consumers,
exactly like stdlib/chain). Checkpoint 1 contains the tokenizer; the rest of
the engine kernels/loaders fold in here behind the same module.

Tokenizer (Qwen3 / GPT-2 byte-level BPE): reads the model's
{vocab.json, merges.txt} from VYB_LLM_DIR (a model's artifacts are passed in,
never hardcoded to a consumer's repo path) and implements
  encode(text) -> Vec<Int> of token ids
using the standard byte-level BPE algorithm:
  1. map each utf-8 BYTE of the input through the GPT-2/Qwen
     bytes_to_unicode table -> a string of "byte-chars",
  2. pre-tokenize (word/space split — see the simplification note below),
  3. greedily apply byte-pair merges by lowest rank (merges.txt order),
  4. map final byte-token strings to ids via vocab.json (exact, unescaped),
     with a per-byte fallback if a merged token is somehow missing.

FAITHFUL algorithmic reproduction of the Qwen2 pre-tokenize regex, also
handling punctuation and standalone apostrophes (Vyb's regex module is POSIX
ERE only — no \p{L}/\p{N} classes — so instead of the regex this segments
letters / single-digits / punctuation per the `[^L/N]?L+` leading-punct and
space-before-punct rules). VERIFIED EXACT vs transformers on plain words,
contractions, leading/trailing apostrophes, punctuation, and whitespace runs.
Non-ASCII (Unicode-letter) words may still diverge (no Unicode regex).

---------------- high-level Model facade ----------------
A Model owns its tokenizer artifacts dir (per-deployment, so admin and
os-builder LoRAs can coexist) and binds tokenize/decode/sample to it. The
GPU forward (weights, bindings/cuda, kernels) is NOT here — it is the
hardware/capability seam the OS/Forge consume as a binding (see
VybOS/doc/VYBLLM-ARCHITECTURE.md §3/§7); this facade is the portable,
model-agnostic CPU core plus a stable surface for a higher `llm::` layer to
compose both paths.
